docs.title: Probe Diagnostics names new chief executive
docs.text: Probe Diagnostics AG announced that Dr. Lena Hartmann has been appointed CEO effective 1 June 2026, succeeding founder Marc Keller who steps down after 18 years. The board said the appointment marks a new commercial chapter for the Zug-based diagnostics group. Hartmann previously led the EMEA commercial organisation of a large medtech company.

docs.title: Probe Diagnostics is hiring: Head of CRM & Commercial Data
docs.text: Probe Diagnostics is hiring a Head of CRM and Commercial Data based in Zug. The job posting lists the build-out of a unified customer data platform among the first-year objectives. Applications close at the end of April.

docs.title: Probe Diagnostics opens Iberian subsidiary
docs.text: Probe Diagnostics has completed the acquisition of its Madrid-based distributor Iberia Dx and will operate it as a wholly owned subsidiary. Management described the deal as the first step of a broader southern-European expansion. Integration of the two sales organisations is expected to take twelve months.

docs.title: Perplexity Sonar — Probe Diagnostics AG
docs.text: According to financial press reports, a mid-market private equity fund is said to have acquired a minority stake in Probe Diagnostics. No transaction value was disclosed and no primary source could be identified.

docs.title: Probe Diagnostics receives ISO renewal
docs.text: Probe Diagnostics announced the renewal of its ISO 13485 certification for its Zug manufacturing site. The certificate covers the design and production of in-vitro diagnostic instruments. The company thanked its quality team for the smooth audit.
